apps.name: StikDebug
apps.subtitle: On-device debugger and JIT enabler
apps.localizedDescription: An on-device debugger and JIT enabler for iOS 17.4 and newer, powered by idevice.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed
* Adds on-device pairing file creation and management for the local device, as well as external devices (Apple TV included)
* Error cleanup
* Fixes some connection issues
* Prevent stale legacy pairing files overriding fresh imports by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/pull/479
* Revert "Prevent stale legacy pairing files overriding fresh imports" by @CelloSerenity in https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/pull/486
* fix: release the route when playback finishes so a new spot can be set by @OpenUmar in https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/pull/490
* more prob

## New Contributors
* @mvanhorn made their first contribution in https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/pull/479
* @OpenUmar made their first contribution in https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/pull/490

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/compare/3.1.15...3.2.0
